WITH d AS (SELECT calendar_date AS business_date FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date BETWEEN '2025-12-15' AND '2025-12-23'),
sales AS (SELECT sale_date AS business_date, sum(net_amount) AS sales_net FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_id IN (2,3) AND sale_date BETWEEN '2025-12-15' AND '2025-12-23' GROUP BY 1),
refunds AS (SELECT r.return_date AS business_date, sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line s ON s.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id WHERE s.channel_id IN (2,3) AND r.return_date BETWEEN '2025-12-15' AND '2025-12-23' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT d.business_date, coalesce(s.sales_net,0)-coalesce(r.refunds_net,0) AS web_net_sales, s.sales_net AS before_returns, r.refunds_net AS returns
FROM d LEFT JOIN sales s USING(business_date) LEFT JOIN refunds r USING(business_date) ORDER BY 1
